$comment: The sub-decision inventory. Read by the generation method to know WHAT to vary for a target — doctrine rule 40: 'what to vary comes from the component's anatomy, not from invention'. Tier + parts + required states come from C1 §3-4; the required-state floor and its meaning come from B2 §3. A round's sub-decisions ARE these parts and states, never invented. NEVER read by a scoring runner; this is generation input.

meta.naming: Parts use parent-prepended names (C1 §3.5): CardTitle, not a bare Title. States are never variants (C1 §3.4).

primitive.definition: one interactive/display concern, nothing named nested inside, repeats many times (Button, Badge, Avatar). C1 §3.1
primitive.render_surface: the component rendered across its REQUIRED STATES, pinned open side by side — so the axis is judged where it lives, not in a collapsed state. A primitive round shows e.g. rest/hover/focus-visible/active/disabled in one strip.

composite.definition: assembles >=2 primitives and OWNS the state orchestration between them, repeats several times (Card, Dialog, Tabs, Toast). C1 §3.1
composite.min_anatomy: root + (trigger if not always-visible) + content region + an explicit dismiss-or-commit affordance
composite.render_surface: 1-3 real instances at real content density, with the required states of the orchestrating part pinned open (e.g. one card shown in its hover-revealed state).

surface.definition: a page-level layout region, usually once per screen (App-shell, Page-header, Empty-state). C1 §3.1
surface.render_surface: rendered once at real density. Do NOT render a whole surface to decide a primitive/composite question — that is a rung error (order of magnitude more cost, and it hides the axis if it lives in a collapsed region).

state_matrix.$comment: B2 §3.1: the whole matrix, not three states. C1 only says WHICH apply per tier (rule 11); B2 owns what each looks like. Every state carrying meaning also changes a NON-colour channel (B2 §3.2, = floor-not-colour-alone).

always.hover: pointer over (never fires on touch/keyboard) — hover is polish, never the only affordance (B2 §3.5)
always.focus-visible: keyboard focus landed — ring >=2px, >=3:1, via outline+outline-offset (B2 §3.13, A5)
always.disabled: removed from tab order + a11y tree, exempt from contrast (B2 §3.10). NOT the same as read-only

conditional.loading: add when the component is asynchronous — skeleton/spinner by the timing ladder (B2 §3.6-3.7)
conditional.error: add when it has a validity concept — aria-invalid + aria-describedby (B2 §3.3)
conditional.selected: add when it is selectable — aria-selected/aria-current
conditional.read-only: add when the value is shown-but-not-editable; stays focusable + announced (B2 §3.10)

media-card.cross_ref: the Screenroom poster card; the demo target
media-card.required_variant_floor: at least a default + one state-signalling treatment (owned vs watchlist here)

sub_decisions.hint: 0 sharp (data/tech voice) .. 8 friendly .. 20 soft (A4 rule 116); pick a tight OR a loose, not three
flat hairline vs dual-layer tinted shadow (A4 120-121); on dark prefer +lightness over shadow
2:3 poster vs 16:9 still; object-fit:cover, never fill (D2 157)
overlaid-on-media vs below-media vs hover-revealed footer
0/1/2 meta lines; tabular-nums for any rating/year (C3 160)
always-visible vs hover-reveal; a hover-revealed CONTROL needs :focus-within (adv-hover-control-focus-within, B2 3.5)
content-derived accent on <= a few surfaces (border/badge/CTA), neutral elsewhere; 60/30/10 (A1 62)
pill vs corner-ribbon vs none; status via a second channel, not colour alone (B2 3.2)
lift (translateY) vs scale vs none; transform+opacity only, 250-300ms standard (B1 70,74)
how 'selected' reads — ring vs fill vs check; a non-colour channel required

button.required_variant_floor: primary + secondary at minimum (C1 §3.10); tone (danger/success) is a SEPARATE axis, never folded into emphasis (C1 §3.3)

sub_decisions.hint: how primary/secondary/tertiary/ghost differ — a variant enum, mutually exclusive (C1 §3.2)
sharp / 6-8 / pill 9999 (A4 116)
direction-aware lightness move (A1 67), not a hardcoded second hex; 100-150ms micro (B1 70)
outline-based, >=2px/3:1, never box-shadow-only (adv-focus-ring-not-shadow-only)
leading/trailing/none; icon-only needs aria-label (C1 §3.12); one icon set (D2 145)
spinner vs label-swap; aria-busy; keep width stable (no jitter)

data-table-row.required_variant_floor: a resting row + a selected row treatment

sub_decisions.hint: compact 32 / default 40-48 / relaxed 56 (C3 159)
hairline 1px ~8-12% opacity (safer default) vs zebra (unproven, C3 165)
numeric right + tabular-nums, text left (C3 160)
translucent state layer so it inverts in dark (B2 3.14)
1-2 inline vs overflow menu; hover-revealed controls need :focus-within + >=24px hit area (C3 164)
checkbox vs whole-row click; aria-selected; a non-colour selected signal
